summary: Collects the ASN.1 definitions of the component matching rules for LDAP and X.500 directories into one properly identified ASN.1 module. That lets other specifications import those definitions into their own ASN.1 modules. It updates the earlier rules in RFC 3687 in form rather than adding new behavior.

plainLanguage.summary: RFC 3727 gathers the ASN.1 definitions for LDAP and X.500 component matching rules into a named module. Other specifications can import those definitions instead of copying them.

subtitle: An ASN.1 module that lets other specifications reference LDAP and X.500 component matching rules.

tldr.problem: Other specifications need a named ASN.1 module from which they can import the component matching rule definitions for LDAP and X.500.
tldr.mechanism: The RFC collects the existing component matching ASN.1 definitions into a module with an identifier and imports the required directory types.
tldr.outcome: It updates RFC 3687 by organizing its definitions for reuse and does not change the matching-rule definitions themselves.

today: The unit metadata lists RFC 3727's status as Proposed Standard. It updates RFC 3687 by collecting existing definitions into an ASN.1 module.

sections.title: Why Gather the Definitions
sections.content:
Directory attributes can hold simple values such as text, integers, or booleans, as well as complex structured data. RFC 3687 defines matching rules that can select components within an attribute value.

This RFC collects the ASN.1 definitions of those rules in an appropriately identified module so another ASN.1 specification can reference them directly.
sections.plainLanguage: Some directory attributes contain complex values with parts that can be searched. This RFC puts the relevant rule definitions in one module other specifications can reuse.

sections.title: The ComponentMatching Module
sections.content:
The module defines the structures used for component assertions and filters. A component assertion can identify a component, select a matching rule, and provide a value; a component filter can combine assertions with AND, OR, or NOT.

The module also names the component-filter, all-components, directory-components, relative-distinguished-name, and present matching rules. It imports matching-rule and relative-distinguished-name definitions from the directory InformationFramework module.
sections.plainLanguage: The module describes how a filter can select parts of a directory value and combine those tests. It also gives the matching rules names and identifiers that other specifications can reference.

sections.title: What This RFC Changes
sections.content:
The RFC updates RFC 3687 by collecting its ASN.1 definitions in a module. It explicitly says that it does not modify the component matching definitions themselves.

Security considerations for using the matching rules remain those described in RFC 3687, which this module document references.
sections.plainLanguage: This RFC changes how the definitions are packaged, not what the matching rules mean. It points readers to the earlier specification for their security considerations.
